verdict.rationale: Northwest Registered Agent is a registered-agent and business-formation service, not a platform where users author automations or workflows. Versioning, reviewing, and rolling back user-built automations is therefore a category error for this kind of product. The evidence pack contains no first-party corpus (the site returned a Cloudflare challenge), and nothing in it suggests the product ships an automation engine that would make this axis apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
